title: LLM-Based Automatic Architecture Optimization for AI Model HLS Implementation on FPGA
extraction_scope: Read-only inspection of pinned repository tree, README, HLS script, top-level kernel and stored text/XML synthesis reports; no execution or full-paper recovery

artifact.scope: Fire module HLS and hardware project; README promises further modules, full-model integration and automation in future

inspected_script.limit: Synthesis/export commands do not establish functional equivalence or hardware timing closure.

observations: 32-bit AXI stream payload unpacked as float
Squeeze convolution and ReLU followed by duplicated stream
Two expand convolution/ReLU branches joined by concatenation
Weights included from static text files
inspected_kernel.limit: Source inspection only; no dynamic correctness, deadlock, performance or provenance-of-generation test.

stored_synthesis_report.crosscheck: Selected timing, latency, interval and total resource fields agree between text and XML reports.
limits: Top-level latency is distinct from launch interval; neither is end-to-end model latency.
HLS estimated clock is not achieved post-route timing.
Resource totals exclude any unrepresented system integration costs.
Stored report timestamp predates the pinned release; source/report reproducibility has not been established.
No matched baseline or full-suite aggregation in these reports establishes 11.78x.

attempts.outcome: Official description and author faculty page recovered; author page identifies partial repository. No full manuscript recovered.
Resolved immutable commit/tree; inspected README and selected source/script.

unresolved_conditions: Full benchmark model suite and baseline implementations
Definition and aggregation of 11.78x average performance
HLS estimates versus post-route or board measurements
Resource budgets, timing closure and accuracy constraints
LLM identity/version, prompts, retries, token/cost budget and generation success rate
Full optimization driver and ablation connecting generated architecture to improvements
interpretation_limits: A released example is not the entire LLM-driven framework.
README platform configuration cannot be assigned to every paper benchmark without full text.
Commented simulation commands do not prove authors never tested correctness; they limit what this script reproduces.
Artifact discovery is not independent acceptance.
revisit_condition: Full paper or framework release with benchmarks, prompts and equivalence tests, or a licensed synthesis environment and functional testbench enabling fresh verification.
